summary: Numbers 19 to Deuteronomy 18: 20 new, 11 extend and 122 parallel findings; most are Deuteronomy restatements and Numbers 28-29 festival offerings to link to Exodus-Leviticus records, while new gaps include the murder death penalty, local slaughter, priestly foreleg and fleece dues, the Weeks additional offering and Deuteronomy 8:3.
